_note: The people published on /people/: ids from conferences/people.json (ai.engineer speaker slugs), in two groups, proposed by rule and approved by hand. Both need a technical role (engineer, researcher, scientist, technical staff, CTO, founding or co-founder, maintainer) and a talk since 2025; developer relations, evangelists, curators, investors, product, marketing, managers, authors and widely known names are left out, because the page is about who builds. 'builders': three or more talks or two editions, a GitHub link, at most two per organisation. 'quiet': one edition and at most two talks, no other score needed, ranked by their idea: how few other speakers share the topics of their talk. One per organisation. Remove an id to unpublish; add one to publish.
